description: Source code for the Android Input Driver implementation, including class definitions, method implementations, and HAL interface functions for input device management.

classes.name: InputDriver
classes.description: Class implementing the input device driver, managing device creation, report handling, and property management.

methods.name: InputDriver::InputDriver
methods.description: Constructor initializing the driver with the specified name and loading the input module.

methods.name: InputDriver::init
methods.description: Initializes the input driver with the hardware module.

methods.name: InputDriver::createDeviceIdentifier
methods.description: Creates a new device identifier with specified parameters.

methods.name: InputDriver::createDeviceDefinition
methods.description: Creates a new device definition object.

methods.name: InputDriver::createInputReportDefinition
methods.description: Creates a new input report definition object.

methods.name: InputDriver::createOutputReportDefinition
methods.description: Creates a new output report definition object.

methods.name: InputDriver::freeReportDefinition
methods.description: Frees a report definition object.

methods.name: InputDriver::inputDeviceDefinitionAddReport
methods.description: Adds a report to a device definition.

methods.name: InputDriver::inputReportDefinitionAddCollection
methods.description: Adds a collection to a report definition.

methods.name: InputDriver::inputReportDefinitionDeclareUsageInt
methods.description: Declares an integer usage in a report collection.

methods.name: InputDriver::inputReportDefinitionDeclareUsagesBool
methods.description: Declares boolean usages in a report collection.

methods.name: InputDriver::registerDevice
methods.description: Registers a device with its identifier and definition, returning a device handle.

methods.name: InputDriver::unregisterDevice
methods.description: Unregisters and deletes a device handle.

methods.name: InputDriver::inputAllocateReport
methods.description: Allocates a new input report based on a report definition.

methods.name: InputDriver::inputReportSetUsageInt
methods.description: Sets an integer usage value in a report.

methods.name: InputDriver::inputReportSetUsageBool
methods.description: Sets a boolean usage value in a report.

methods.name: InputDriver::reportEvent
methods.description: Reports an input event for a device.

methods.name: InputDriver::inputGetDevicePropertyMap
methods.description: Retrieves the property map for a device, loading configuration if available.

methods.name: InputDriver::inputGetDeviceProperty
methods.description: Gets a specific property value from a device property map.

methods.name: InputDriver::inputGetPropertyKey
methods.description: Returns the key string of a property.

methods.name: InputDriver::inputGetPropertyValue
methods.description: Returns the value string of a property.

methods.name: InputDriver::inputFreeDeviceProperty
methods.description: Deletes a property object.

methods.name: InputDriver::inputFreeDevicePropertyMap
methods.description: Deletes a property map object.

methods.name: InputDriver::dump
methods.description: Outputs driver information into a String8 buffer.
